first_missing_criterion: HM Land Registry's official public Transaction unique identifier and UPRN Look Up Table provides a current, OGL identifier bridge from published Price Paid transactions to UPRNs, and documents that its relationship depends on the registered title/address and the National Polygon Service Title Number↔UPRN lookup. This is a new official identifier route that can connect transaction evidence to UPRN-addressable property. However Title Numbers are not published in Price Paid Data, this lookup contains identifiers only, and the project's canonical_parcel_id inventory/polygons or an exact canonical_parcel_id↔transaction/UPRN binding are not exposed in this public window. Therefore no real building footprint and proven building type can be deterministically bound to a project canonical parcel; accepted_count remains zero.
next_method_requirement: new official public no-login window exposing exact project canonical_parcel_id Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry or canonical_parcel_id↔transaction/UPRN/title/TOID binding, plus a real footprint and proven building type
